Drawback: Sensory Overload.name: Drawback: Sensory Overload
Drawback: Sensory Overload.description:
🎧 Using your Quirk opens your senses wider than your brain can sort.

⚠️ Noise, light and crowds hit harder the more you push.
🔊 You are vulnerable to sonic damage: sound attacks always hurt you more.

🎒 Starts with: Noise-filtering earpieces
💢 Weak to: sonic
Drawback: Sensory Overload.traitNarrativeEffects: Quirk use sharpens the senses (sound, light, smell, touch) past what the brain filters. Sonic weakness is constant: blasts and sound attacks hurt the user more than others, even at rest. Quirk Strain 60 (50 for an Exceptional Quirk): headache, light sensitivity, flinching at sudden sounds. Quirk Strain 80: the drawback is active; a bang, siren or bright flash staggers the user and breaks focus, and any use beyond light risks losing track of where things are. Quirk Strain 100: senses white out (migraine, nosebleed, ringing ears), a serious injury; no Quirk use until Strain is below 60. Signs fade as Strain drops below each threshold. Noise-filtering earpieces, worn, keep ordinary noise bearable and soften the 60 stage; they do not remove the sonic weakness or stop the 80 or 100 stages. Ordinary life: crowded trains, festivals, stadiums, fireworks and karaoke are hard. Quirkless: no Quirk or Strain; earpieces: spare gear, the sonic weakness inborn sensitive hearing.
